description:
pattern     case-stack / comparison
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Columns 1–12 lead with the transformation title, followed by 4 paired milestone cards displaying documentary photographs and first-person reflections, concluding with a prominent full-width frosted glass before-and-after reflection banner. On mobile, milestones stack chronologically.
copy
  eyebrow      REFLECTION & EVOLUTION
  heading      Who I Was → Who I Became
  item-1-title The Initial Spark
  item-1-refl  I arrived uncertain of my technical voice, intimidated by the sheer depth of computer science and wondering if I could stand out.
  item-2-title Embracing the Friction
  item-2-refl  I realized that bugs and compile failures were not signs of inadequacy, but the exact mechanism through which an engineer is forged.
  item-3-title Expanding the Horizon
  item-3-refl  I learned that the best software is built through empathy, teamwork, and clear communication rather than isolated solo hacking.
  item-4-title Ready for the Horizon
  item-4-refl  I leave the University of Vavuniya with grounded confidence, battle-tested technical discipline, and an insatiable hunger to build systems that matter.
  summary-stmt "I entered as an uncertain freshman writing syntax; I graduate as a resilient technologist architecting solutions for real human needs."
image       16:9; set of 4 documentary milestone photographs showing first day on campus, late night solo debugging, multi-team hackathon collaboration, and standing confident in graduation attire; placed in each milestone card, treatment documentary; alt: Personal transformation milestones of Tharindu Perera
motion      Milestone comparison cards slide into view with 80ms stagger; final before/after banner pulses with subtle border glow.
plan check  heading "Who I Was → Who I Became" placed; set of 4 milestone moments each with a photo and a short personal reflection placed; closing before/after statement placed.
layout_description: Two-column milestone comparison grid followed by a full-width centered glass before-and-after reflection callout.
